parameters.query:
SELECT id, sku, name, description, price, currency
FROM products
WHERE active = true
  AND business_id = $2::uuid
  AND (name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR sku ILIKE $1)
LIMIT 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.product_name_or_sku || '' }}, {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.business_id }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO quotes (business_id, contact_id, conversation_id, quote_number, status, subtotal, tax, discount, total, currency, notes, valid_until, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $9, $5, 0, 0, $6, $7, $8, NOW() + INTERVAL '14 days', $10)
ON CONFLICT (quote_number) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, quote_number, total, currency, valid_until;
